import json, unreal
world=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.UnrealEditorSubsystem).get_editor_world()
rows=[]
for actor in unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem).get_all_level_actors():
    comps=actor.get_components_by_class(unreal.NiagaraComponent)
    for comp in comps:
        asset=comp.get_asset()
        rows.append({'label':actor.get_actor_label(),'actor':actor.get_path_name(),'component':comp.get_path_name(),'asset':asset.get_path_name() if asset else None,'active':bool(comp.is_active()),'visible':bool(comp.is_visible())})
print('PERF_CURRENT_NIAGARA_ACTORS='+json.dumps({'world':world.get_path_name(),'actors':rows},sort_keys=True))
